items: Fix: the UEFN MCP card showed "The kit uses 18 of 388 tools". In v1.107.0 the count read only the short list in `reference/` and ignored `hooks/mcp-known-tools.json` (the 388-tool file with what the lab found for each tool). It now adds every tool the lab marked `ok` or `recipe`, and matches full names (`Toolset/Tool`) and short ones. With the shipped data the card shows 359 of 388 (92.5%).
release.title: v1.107.1 — The UEFN MCP card shows the real numbers
